name: Water
blurb: You are looking for a Charles River. There are three, and they are all better.

places.name: Green Lake Park
places.note: 2.8 miles around, flat, and always full of people. If you are missing the Charles on a Saturday, start here.
places.address: Green Lake Park, 7201, Green Lake, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98115, United States

places.name: Lake Union Park
places.note: South end of Lake Union. The Cheshiahud Loop runs six miles around the whole lake from here.
places.address: Lake Union Park, 860, Cascade, Belltown, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98109, United States

places.name: Gas Works Park
places.note: The north shore, looking back at downtown across the water. Best skyline in the city and nobody argues.
places.address: Gas Works Park, 2101, Fremont, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98103, United States

places.name: Alki Beach Park
places.note: Two and a half miles of actual beach with the skyline across the bay. Feels like a different city.
places.address: Alki Beach Park, West Seattle, Seattle, King County, Washington, United States

places.name: Golden Gardens Park
places.note: Ballard. Sand, driftwood, legal beach fires, and the Olympics going pink at sunset.
places.address: Golden Gardens Park, 8498, Ballard, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98117, United States

places.name: Seward Park
places.note: A 300-acre peninsula in Lake Washington with a 2.4-mile loop and old-growth forest in the middle.
places.address: Seward Park, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98118, United States

places.name: Madison Park Beach
places.note: Small, calm, residential. Swimming raft in summer and far fewer people than Green Lake.
places.address: Madison Park Beach, Washington Park, Madison Park, Seattle, King County, Washington, United States

places.name: Warren G. Magnuson Park
places.note: Former naval air station on Lake Washington. Big open sky, an off-leash beach for dogs.
places.address: Warren G. Magnuson Park, 7400, Sand Point, Seattle, King County, Washington, 98115, United States
